fieldValues.title: Graduate two charter-background notes' rationale, correct stale #273 citations
fieldValues.summary: Adds the missing derived-from relation from DN-045 to the 'Design Jurisprudence' note (already named in its prose but never asserted as a relation); corrects both notes' graduation_trigger text and the reachability-exclusion reasons, which cited #273 as the charter-self-hosting graduation vehicle - a mismatch, since #273 was the Metamodel v1.1.0 task, and the source-of-truth map (srs#639) has since ruled the Pattern Grid's cells live in JSON config, not a 'matrix' of typed records.
fieldValues.body: PR https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/764. Neither note's original graduation target exists: 'Taste Made Portable' (7e8d9753) stays pending, re-pointed from the closing #631 to #580 (Wave 2). 'Design Jurisprudence' (ac55018f) partially graduates now via a new derived-from relation to DN-045, which already carries the graduated content in its 'Forward framing' paragraph; its remaining SRS-for-Specs/Epic-13 thread stays pending under #580. Gates: srs repo validate 0 errors, validate-all.mjs and check-release-drift.mjs both green.
